sloka: अथैतत् पृष्ठत: कृत्वा वनमेव भवानित: ।गमिष्यति गमिष्यामि भवता सार्द्धमप्यहम् ॥ २.१०६.३२॥
transliteration: athaitat pṛṣṭhata: kṛtvā vanameva bhavānita: ।gamiṣyati gamiṣyāmi bhavatā sārddhamapyaham ॥ 2.106.32॥

translations.english: If you turn your back on my solicitations and set out for the forest I shall also go along with you from here itself.
